_about: Plants whose only difference from each other is data. guards.mjs maps over this list instead of writing structurally identical object literals in JavaScript: SonarCloud's duplication detector flagged 48 lines of the tuple table that preceded this file (new_duplicated_lines_density 68.6% with every string in every row different), because its JS detector compares token structure rather than literal text. Keeping these rows as JSON data also means adding another is one entry, not a code change.
_fields: name, what the defect is (desc), file, anchor (must occur exactly once), replacement, test (the vitest file that must go red), pattern (a metachar-free substring of the arm title — vitest's -t is a regex)
